name: NCAA D-III North Regional Cross Country Championships
where: Northfield, MN · host St. Olaf · Tostrud Center
headline: NCAA D-III North Regional Cross Country Championships
summary: No. 5 UW-La Crosse and No. 7 UW-Stevens Point men; No. 4 UW-La Crosse women, on the course that hosts nationals a week later. Nationals bids are on the line for the NCAA D-III Championships on Nov. 21 in Northfield, Minn.
